# 30Avenue

> 30Avenue is a shopping, dining and services destination at the Gateway to 30A® in Inlet Beach, Florida, where 30A meets Highway 98.

Nestled at the Gateway to 30A®, 30Avenue is more than a shopping center — it’s a beautifully orchestrated lifestyle destination. It is home to 35 businesses — restaurants, boutiques, salons and medical care, an arcade, banking, real estate and schools — spread across buildings lettered A to T. Its event calendar listed live music every night from October 5 to October 13, 2026.

Cite as: 30Avenue, Inlet Beach, Florida — https://www.30avenue.com/

## Contact
- Address: 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461
- Phone: (850) 231-1127
- Hours: each business sets its own hours (listed below and on https://www.30avenue.com/map/)
- Area: Inlet Beach, Florida (South Walton), where 30A meets Highway 98
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/30avenue
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/30ave/

## Who this is for
Visitors and locals on 30A looking for somewhere to eat, shop, get things done or spend an evening.

## Questions people ask
**Where is 30Avenue?**
12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461, where 30A meets Highway 98.

**How do suite numbers work?**
Each suite starts with its building letter. Suite B100 is in Building B.

**Is there parking?**
Yes — parking lots surround the buildings.

**Can I walk or bike there?**
The U.S. 98 pedestrian underpass just east of County Road 30A gives people on foot and on bikes a safe crossing beneath U.S. 98.

Nestled at the Gateway to 30A®, 30Avenue is more than a shopping center — it’s a beautifully orchestrated lifestyle destination.

30Avenue is a shopping, dining and services destination at 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461, where 30A meets Highway 98. Phone (850) 231-1127.

## Events & Live Music on 30A | 30Avenue Calendar
URL: https://www.30avenue.com/calendar/

# 30Avenue event calendar

- 2026-10-05 (Mon) 6:00pm — Live Music with Robbie Paynter: Lead vocalist of local band About to Sweat, playing solo with a drumpad, guitar, mini keyboard and loop station.
- 2026-10-06 (Tue) 6:00pm — Live Music with Hunter Dawson: An energetic, positive show for all ages — reggae and pop on the green.
- 2026-10-07 (Wed) 6:00pm — Live Music with Mari Gleason & Jess Murphy: Soaring violin solos, indie-folk favorites and crowd singalongs.
- 2026-10-08 (Thu) 6:00pm — Live Music with Fox Play: Country, rock, blues and pop.
- 2026-10-09 (Fri) 6:00pm — Live Music with James Terry: A multi-instrumentalist trained in saxophone and piano, now focused on bass.
- 2026-10-10 (Sat) 6:30pm — Live Music with The Sand ole Opry: Dinner, drinks and live music from a rock band from South Walton, 30A, Grayton Beach and Seaside.
- 2026-10-11 (Sun) 6:00pm — Live Music with Mark Payne: Sing-along favorites from the ’60s and ’70s.
- 2026-10-12 (Mon) 6:00pm — Live Music with Timmy Hood: A singer and songwriter who participated in Season 17 of The Voice.
- 2026-10-13 (Tue) 6:00pm — Live Music with John Hart: A night of blues and classic rock on classic guitar.
- 2026-10-13 (Tue) 6:00pm — 30Autumn Riverain Wine Dinner with Cuvee 30A: A wine dinner at Cuvee 30A.

## Eat at 30Avenue, Inlet Beach FL | 30A
URL: https://www.30avenue.com/dining/

# Eat & drink at 30Avenue

From breakfast at Canopy Road Cafe to dinner at Cuvee 30A — places to eat and drink at the Gateway to 30A®.

### Aja Elevated Asian

- Location: Suite T101, 30Avenue, 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461
- Category: Eat
- Hours: 5pm–10pm daily
- Phone: 850-493-6437
- Website: https://www.aja30a.com/

Master Chef Tom Catherall has created a menu showcasing elevated Asian cuisines, with authentic dishes such as sushi, sashimi, stir-fries and noodle dishes. A modern and stylish atmosphere, ideal for a night out with friends or a romantic dinner for two.
- Page: https://www.30avenue.com/directory/aja-elevated-asian/

### amici 30A Italian Kitchen

- Location: Suite R101, 30Avenue, 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461
- Category: Eat
- Hours: 11am–9pm daily
- Phone: 850-909-0555
- Website: https://www.amici30a.com/

Authentic Italian cuisine with a flair for celebration. Fresh, handmade dishes cooked to order in a lively exhibition kitchen with a Marsal pizza oven — garden fresh salads, Italian small plates, signature dishes, cocktails and an array of gelato flavors in a welcoming, family-style atmosphere.
- Page: https://www.30avenue.com/directory/amici-30a-italian-kitchen-2/

### amigo’s 30A Mexican Kitchen

- Location: Suite Q101, 30Avenue, 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461
- Category: Eat
- Hours: 11am–9pm daily
- Phone: 850-909-0444
- Website: https://www.amigos30a.com/

Authentic Mexican cuisine with a flair for celebration, in a welcoming, family-style atmosphere.
- Page: https://www.30avenue.com/directory/amigos-30a-mexican-kitchen/

### Canopy Road Cafe

- Location: Suite B100, 30Avenue, 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461
- Category: Eat
- Hours: 6:30am–2pm daily
- Phone: 850-909-0104
- Website: https://canopyroadcafe.com/

Made from scratch traditional breakfasts, fluffy omelets, French toast and giant pancakes — plus lunch favorites including salads, sandwiches, wraps and a juicy ½ pound steak burger.
- Page: https://www.30avenue.com/directory/canopy-road-cafe/

### Cuvee 30A

- Location: Suite D101, 30Avenue, 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461
- Category: Eat
- Hours: Dinner 4pm–9pm Mon–Sat
- Phone: 850-909-0111
- Website: https://cuvee30a.com/

Celebrity Chef Tim Creehan’s Cuvee 30A, as seen on Emeril’s Florida. Signature dishes such as Amy Grant’s Seared Tuna Rare and Vince Gill’s Pecan Crusted Grouper, at the junction of 30A and Highway 98.
- Page: https://www.30avenue.com/directory/cuvee-30a/

### Goatfeathers Seafood Market

- Location: Suite O101, 30Avenue, 12805 US-98 East, Inlet Beach, FL 32461
- Category: Eat
- Hours: 11am–7pm daily
- Phone: 850-909-0090
- Website: https://www.goatfeathersseafood.com/goatfeathers-at-30avenue

Nothing fancy, just the way you want it. A local favorite seafood restaurant, fish market and specialty store — fresh fish cut from the market, homemade sauces and soups. Dine in or take your freshly steamed meal to go.
- Page: https://www.30avenue.com/directory/goatfeathers-seafood-market/

### Great American Cookies

## News & Updates | 30Avenue, Inlet Beach FL
URL: https://www.30avenue.com/news/

# 30Avenue news

## Pedestrian underpass now open

The U.S. 98 pedestrian underpass in Inlet Beach is now open. Located just east of County Road 30A, it gives pedestrians and cyclists a safe, convenient crossing beneath U.S. 98.

## Hello Sugar pops up

A charming Airstream candy boutique popped up at 30Avenue, with fresh cotton candy in flavors like Pink Vanilla, Chocolate and Birthday Cake.

## Aja now open

Introducing Aja, the latest addition to the 30Avenue dining scene, with a menu of elevated Asian cuisines by Master Chef Tom Catherall.
